subject: SIG evidence: KMS rotation proof, session logs, and final handback
messages:
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@luminarytx.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: SIG evidence: KMS rotation proof, session logs, and initial artifact bundle

Hi Elena,

Thanks for the checklist. Attached and linked below is the initial evidence bundle for the KMS rotation and session artifacts you requested for the SIG questionnaire. I tried to group items by ask to make review easier. Please confirm receipt and tell me if you need redacted versions or additional screenshots.

Included (drive links and stubs):
- KMS rotation manifest + proof (redwood-kms-rotation-20261015.pdf) — Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_kms-rotation-evidence
- Ephemeral session screenshots (ephemeral-session-screenshots-202610.zip) — Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1XyZ_session-screenshots
- Access logs export (access-logs-202609.csv) — attached stub; truncated export with columns: timestamp, user, action, session_id
- Runbook: key-rotation-runbook-v2.md (link inside the KMS folder)

Notes:
- The KMS rotation occurred on 2026-10-15; the PDF contains the rotation record, the rotation plan, and the post-rotation verification steps.
- Ephemeral session screenshots include one example of the ephemeral console session and the session expiration metadata. We scrub PII by default; if you need raw timestamps or fuller logs, let me know and we'll provide an export with a narrow scope.

Next steps: please reply with any gaps by EOD Thursday so we can close this ticket for your SIG intake queue. If everything looks good, I'll mark the artifacts as delivered and set Drive shares to View-only for your reviewers.

Thanks,
Rohan Mehta
Senior Technical Program Manager
Redwood Inference
rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com

--
Attachments (stubs): redwood-kms-rotation-20261015.pdf, ephemeral-session-screenshots-202610.zip, access-logs-202609.csv

From: SIG Intake <sig-portal@luminarytx.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 08:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG evidence: KMS rotation proof, session logs, and initial artifact bundle

Rohan,

Received — thanks for the organized bundle. Quick clarification items from our security reviewer:
1) Can you provide a screenshot that shows the KMS key metadata page with the rotation timestamp visible (we need a UI screenshot, not just the PDF log)?
2) For ephemeral sessions, can you confirm the retention policy and provide a single-session raw audit line (unredacted timestamp+session_id) for our tester to correlate with the screenshot?
3) Is the runbook you referenced the live one used for rotations, or an archival copy? We prefer the operational runbook with author/date.

If you can add those three items we should be able to close this scope and move the SIG questionnaire to final review.

Regards,
Elena Morales
Security Compliance Manager
Luminary Therapeutics
elena.morales@luminarytx.com

--

Subject: Re: SIG evidence: KMS rotation proof, session logs, and initial artifact bundle

Elena — thanks for the quick review and clear asks. Looping in Monica (Security Ops) and Mina (Artifact Fulfillment) to add the UI screenshot and the raw audit line.

Short answers:
- The runbook linked in the folder is the operational runbook (key-rotation-runbook-v2.md); it includes author and last-updated metadata. We'll also push a timestamped copy to the artifact folder so you can see the exact file properties.
- Retention: ephemeral sessions are retained for 90 days; most exports are already scoped to a 30-day window by default.

New items added in this update:
- Added: screenshots/kms-key-details-20261015.png (Drive) — shows key name and rotation timestamp.
- Added: logs/raw-session-20261014-20261016.csv (attached stub) — single-session line included for correlation.
- Added: runbooks/key-rotation-runbook-v2-signed.md (Drive) — operational copy with author/date.

Drive links:
- KMS screenshot folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_kms-rotation-evidence
- Session screenshots: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1XyZ_session-screenshots

I've set the Drive shares to View-only for elena.morales@luminarytx.com and added an expiration of 30 days per your policy. Let us know if you need the raw CSV via a different channel.

Thanks — Monica or Mina, can you confirm the attached access-logs CSV and the raw-session line look sufficient for Luminary's tester?

Best,
Rohan
